bodyHtml: §836-6  Short title.  This chapter may be cited as "Uniform Act to Secure the Attendance of Witnesses from Without a State in Criminal Proceedings". [L 1971, c 116, §6; HRS §719-6; ren L 1972, c 9, pt of §1]
